split_unit: global distinct kickoff timestamps; strict 28h purge at every fitted-stage boundary
market_fit_source: earlier outer-fold evaluation forecasts only; never predictions used to fit their own calibrator
primary_weighting: fixture-balanced; all preregistered lines per fixture
uncertainty: paired UTC ISO-week block bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 3601
calibration_diagnostics: reliability bins; intercept and slope; support and uncertainty required before any confirmation
multiplicity: all arms reported; no winner promotion; future confirmation must freeze one candidate per family and calibration noninferiority method/tolerance
stopping: one registered run; fix implementation defects only, no outcome-driven tuning
settlement: preserve V32.1 official gate; this experiment never mutates ledgers

unsupported_targets.BTTS: No V35 BTTS model evaluated in this experiment
unsupported_targets.bookings: Requires separate verified bookmaker label contract
unsupported_targets.team_sides: No validation inherited from match totals
